data.title: Former MP blames debt dispute for shooting of PAO president
data.description: Former MP Chalong Riewraeng cited a debt dispute as prompting him to fatally shoot Nonthaburi Provincial Administration Organisation (PAO) chief Thongchai Yenprasert on Monday, a senior officer said.

data.title: Miscommunication blamed for sacked foreign teacher's threatening post
data.description: SONGKHLA - The director of Hatyaiwittayalai secondary school said on Monday that miscommunication might have led to the threatening online post by a sacked foreign teacher.

data.title: 13 foreigners netted in property-nominee blitz in Hua Hin
data.description: Thirteen foreigners were arrested on Monday when police raided a housing and pool-villa estate in Hua Hin, after they were found using Thai nominee shareholders to buy properties for them.

data.title: Clothes rack falls from highrise onto taxi-motorcyclist
data.description: A clothes-drying rack fell from a highrise balcony onto a motorcycle driver and his passenger in soi Sukhumvit 24, causing the driver to swerve into a nearby car stopped in the traffic.

data.title: Thai property groups sell land to boost liquidity and cut costs
data.description: Property Perfect, Pruksa, Bangkok Land and BJC are offering land and assets worth more than THB20bn as developers prioritise cash flow and lower holding costs.

data.title: Chinese syndicate aide arrested in B54bn crypto laundering case
data.description: A suspected right-hand man of a Chinese crime boss has been arrested in Bangkok in connection with an online fraud and money laundering network believed to have washed more than 54 million baht through cryptocurrency.

data.title: Songsaeng Autotires marks nearly 60 years in Thailand, three generations strong
data.description: Songsaeng Autotires, a family-owned automotive service and tyre company in Thailand, has reaffirmed its commitment to quality service and customer trust as it marks nearly six decades in business, a legacy now carried by its third generation.

data.title: One woman confirmed dead in western Canada wildfire
data.description: MONTREAL (CANADA) - An 80-year-old woman died while fleeing her home to escape a massive wildfire in Canada's British Columbia province, the Royal Canadian Mounted Police (RCMP) said late Sunday.

data.title: CP AXTRA posts H1 2026 revenue of B268.33bn, online sales up 29%
data.description: CP AXTRA Public Company Limited (The Company or CPAXT), the operator of “Makro and Lotus’s,” Store transformation lifts mall occupancy by 4% announced its operating results for the first half of 2026, with total revenue of 268,334 million baht, an increase of 3.6% year-on-year. Online sales via the Makro PRO platform and Lotus’s SMART App grew more than 29%, Store transformation lifts mall occupancy by 4% and out-of-store sales continued to expand, underscoring the strength of the Company’s omnichannel strategy. The Company also advanced its “Happy & Healthy Mall” strategy, raising mall occupancy rates, particularly at newly transformed locations. Together, these results mark a new milestone in enhancing customer experience by seamlessly connecting the three core pillars of the Company’s Retail Ecosystem: online channels, physical stores and shopping mall spaces.

data.title: Former MP arrested after PAO president slain
data.description: Former Nonthaburi MP Chalong Riewraeng was arrested after a man stormed into the provincial administration organisation office and shot dead the PAO president, Thongchai Yenprasert, on Monday morning.

data.title: Chiang Mai safe from flooding, more rain this week
data.description: Irrigation officials have moved to calm fears that Chiang Mai city may be flooded, stressing that the level of the Ping river, a major waterway, remains far below the crisis level.

data.title: Frenzied Thai on Malaysia-Bangkok flight an army officer with mental issues
data.description: Passengers on a flight from Malaysia to Bangkok were startled by a Thai man who became agitated mid-journey, repeatedly shouting demands for the aircraft to land and reportedly attempting to open an exit door.

data.title: Typhoon Dolphin weakens but disrupts travel in east China
data.description: BEIJING - Typhoon Dolphin brought heavy rain to eastern China on Monday, causing hundreds of flight cancellations even as the storm weakened and some cities resumed public transport.

data.title: Self-taught Turkish 'linguist' keeps dead language alive
data.description: CAVUSTEPE, VAN PROVINCE, Turkey - Mehmet Kusman did not spend very long at school, but he traced the ancient inscriptions chiselled into the black basalt rock and read: "Before me there was nothing. But by the power of the god Haldi I founded this city."

data.title: Praise for SWAT officer who arrived in shorts at school shooting
data.description: A special operations officer who was still wearing shorts when he arrived at the scene of the deadly school shooting in Nonthaburi on Friday was off-duty and had shown great spirit in not waiting to change his pants while rushing to protect the public, the police spokesman said on Monday

data.title: MINT Posts 13% Profit Growth in 1H26, Demonstrating Global Resilience
data.description: Bangkok, Thailand – Minor International Public Company Limited (MINT) demonstrated the strength of its diversified, globally-balanced business model, delivering 13% year-on-year net profit growth to THB 3,957 million in 1H26, a result achieved despite a second quarter marked by heightened geopolitical tensions in the Middle East and softer regional travel sentiment. MINT’s broad geographic footprint and disciplined execution turned a challenging environment into another period ofearningsgrowth.

data.title: Tetra pak launch thailands first renewable plantbased dairy packaging
data.description: Chiangmai Freshmilk becomes the first dairy producer in Thailand to use Tetra Rex® Plant-based with Tetra Pak® Craft packaging for its new pasteurised and high-protein milk lines

data.title: Air India captain's initial drug screening prompts further testing after sudden altitude loss
data.description: NEW DELHI - ⁠The ⁠captain of an Air ​India flight from Phuket to New Delhi that encountered a sudden ​loss of altitude last week returned ‌an initial screening result for psychoactive substances, prompting further laboratory testing, India's Civil Aviation Ministry said on Sunday.

data.title: Western Europe experienced hottest June-July on record: EU monitor
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Western Europe experienced its hottest June-July on record as climate change fuels an historic summer of heat, drought and wildfires across the region, the EU's global warming monitor said Monday.

data.title: Lionel Messi bids farewell to father who guided his glittering career
data.description: ROSARIO, Argentina - Argentina football icon Lionel Messi bid farewell on Sunday to his father Jorge, the global star's emotional anchor and agent since childhood who passed away following a battle with cancer aged 68.

data.title: Syria says reached deal with Moscow on fate of Russian bases
data.description: DAMASCUS - Syria said on Sunday that it reached a deal with Russia on the fate of its two bases in the country, which Moscow once used to provide military support to ousted leader Bashar al-Assad during the Syrian civil war.

data.title: Hiroshi Nagai brings his tropical dreams to RCB
data.description: River City Bangkok invites everyone to step into a sun-drenched paradise of eternal nostalgia during "Hiroshi Nagai: Summer Dreaming", which is running at RCB Galleria on the 2nd floor, until Sept 4.

data.title: Romance in the air at Sala Sudasiri Sobha
data.description: Turkish cellist Burak Özkan and Portuguese pianist Bernardo Santos will join hands to delight audiences in Bangkok with "The Grand Tango & Romantic Masterpieces", which will take place at Sala Sudasiri Sobha, Lat Phrao 41 yaek 7-2, on Sunday at 4pm.

data.description: The day of the week you were born on can reveal a lot... Read on.

data.title: Changing landscapes
data.description: The Local Networking Project was launched last year by the Bangkok Art and Culture Centre. The project aims to provide a space for artists from various regions to explore and express their stories through contemporary art.

data.title: Battle Of Fates spin-off House Of Fates  gets the go-ahead from Disney+ Korea
data.description: After Battle Of Fates broke records earlier this year to become the No.1 series premiere of all time on Disney+ Korea, the team behind the smash show are set to return with an exciting new spin-off titled House Of Fates.

data.title: Apec urges businesses to work on their resilience
data.description: Apec business leaders have urged companies to strengthen resilience as geopolitical conflicts, supply-chain disruptions and climate risks create growing uncertainty across the Asia-Pacific economy.

data.title: Action plan for 'open govt' on way
data.description: Thailand is moving to establish its first national action plan for open government, aiming to improve transparency, public participation and access to state information.

data.title: Kurdish PKK criticises Turkey bill on fate of its fighters
data.description: ISTANBUL - Outlawed Kurdish group the PKK on Sunday criticised a proposed Turkish law setting out the fate of its fighters after disarmament, a day before parliament prepares to consider it.

data.title: Thai siblings strike gold, silver
data.description: Thailand's BMX riders delivered a statement of intent for the forthcoming Asian Games in Nagoya, with the Nakpaen brothers claiming gold and silver at the Asian Championships in Malaysia.

data.title: Chinese duo deny Aimsaard sisters Korea Masters glory
data.description: Women's doubles pair Benyapa Aimsaard and Nuntakarn Aimsaard missed out on their first title since July last year after losing in the final of the US$250,000 BWF Korea Masters on Sunday.

data.title: Student charged with Chinese man murder
data.description: CHON BURI: Police arrested a 20-year-old student for allegedly stabbing a Chinese man to death in a room in Sattahip district.
